010000111222333102132030221 - ASI: 24

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  02 = 0 * 2
  03 = 0 * 3
  11 = 1 * 1
  13 = 1 * 3
  21 = 2 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  23 = 2 * 3
  31 = 3 * 1
  111 = 1 * 11
  203 = 2 * 03
  331 = 3 * 31
  0000 = 00 * 00
  0213 = 02 * 13
  0221 = 02 * 21
  2223 = 22 * 23
  010000 = 01 * 0000
  1112223 = 111 * 2223
  2030221 = 203 * 0221
  3310213 = 331 * 0213
  0100001112223 = 010000 * 1112223
  33102132030221 = 3310213 * 2030221
  010000111222333102132030221 = 0100001112223 * 33102132030221
